mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund r INNER JOIN payment pay ON pay.id = r.payment_id INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = pay.appointment_id INNER JOIN patient ON patient.id = a.patient_id INNER JOIN doctor ON doctor.id = a.doctor_id

SELECT r.id AS refund_id, a.id AS appointment_id, pay.order_no, patient.name AS patient_name, doctor.name AS doctor_name, r.amount, r.reason, r.note, r.status, a.status AS appointment_status, CASE WHEN r.status != '退款申请' THEN FALSE WHEN r.reason LIKE '医生停诊：%' THEN FALSE WHEN a.status != '退款中' THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS can_reject, CASE WHEN r.status != '退款申请' THEN '该退款已经处理' WHEN r.reason LIKE '医生停诊：%' THEN '医生停诊产生的强制退款不能拒绝' WHEN a.status != '退款中' THEN '关联预约不是退款中状态，不能恢复预约' ELSE NULL END AS reject_blocked_reason, r.create_time, r.process_time FROM refund r INNER JOIN payment pay ON pay.id = r.payment_id INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = pay.appointment_id INNER JOIN patient ON patient.id = a.patient_id INNER JOIN doctor ON doctor.id = a.doctor_id
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS refund_id, a.id AS appointment_id, a.source_id, patient.user_id AS recipient_user_id, r.status, a.status AS appointment_status, r.reason FROM refund r INNER JOIN payment pay ON pay.id = r.payment_id INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = pay.appointment_id INNER JOIN patient ON patient.id = a.patient_id WHERE r.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund SET status = #{status}, note = #{note}, process_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = '退款申请'
UPDATE appointment SET status = '已支付' WHERE id = #{appointmentId} AND status = '退款中'
UPDATE appointment SET status = '取消' WHERE id = #{appointmentId} AND status = '退款中'
UPDATE source SET remain_count = remain_count + 1 WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND remain_count < total_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_id, operation_type, action, target_type, target_id, target, reason, result ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, 'REFUND_PROCESS', #{action}, 'REFUND', #{refundId}, LEFT(CONCAT('退款ID=', #{refundId}, '，预约ID=', #{appointmentId}), 100), #{note}, '成功' )
